releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Added a custom command and removed the old gamerule for a better user experience. Updated versioning system to improve clarity and understanding.

## New Command
To change the trample level protection, users can now use the command (Mod Menu is still compatible):
> /tramplingProtection [level]

## Levels of Protection
There are four levels of protection to choose from:
- FULL - Farmland protected from everything
- MOBS_ONLY - Farmland protected from only mobs
- PLAYERS_ONLY - Farmland protected from only players
- NONE - Farmland has no protection (like vanilla)

## What's Changed
* Added a custom command and removed the old gamerule for a better user experience. Updated versioning system to improve clarity and understanding.

## New Command
To change the trample level protection, users can now use the command:
> /tramplingProtection [level]

## New Versioning System
The new versioning system follows the rubric of vX.YY.ZZ
* X represents the number of major updates after 1.20. For example, it is currently 1 to represent 1.21 and will eventually be 2 to represent 1.22 or whatever number Mojang decides to use.
* Y represents the last number in the Minecraft versioning system
* Z represents the actual version number of the mod. It is now three because this is the third major change to the mod.

## What's Changed
* Rework for version 1.21.10 by @lisbrecht25

## New Command
To change the level of protection, you can either use Mod Menu (easiest method) or use the gamerule trampleProtectionLevel.

releases.notes:
## Description
This mod prevents your crops/farmland from being trampled by you or wandering mobs. This setting can be toggled through Mod Menu or by updating the gamerule:

> notrampling:crop_protection_level

By default, crops/farmland are protected from everything. This mod is compatible with Fabric and version 1.21.11 of Minecraft.

### Update to No Crop Trampling v1.0
This new version brings Mod Menu compatibility, allowing those who use Mod Menu to quickly and easily change the level of protection of crops. Version 1.1 also brings different levels of protection for your farmlands. Instead of just on and off, you can now choose between three levels of protection: 
- Protected from everything
- Protected from mobs but not the player
- Protected from nothing
